We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Wu (defendant) involved in concealment and transfer of shares of a coal mine that were proceeds from illegal public fundraising (illegal absorption of public deposits). The public prosecution says Wu concealed and transferred assets (shares) that are proceeds from illegal public deposit crime. They charge him with money laundering? The text: "公诉机关当庭明确指控的洗钱数额为5200万某。" So they are charging money laundering. In the list, there is a label "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". That corresponds to money laundering (concealing and disguising criminal proceeds). Also possibly "非法吸收公众存款" is the underlying crime, but Wu is not the one who did illegal public deposit; he is facilitating. The charge is money laundering. The list includes "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". So answer should be that.

Check if any other charges: maybe "职务侵占"? No. He is not a public official. He is a private person. So only money laundering.

Thus final answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益<eoa>
